entries.title: John 15:1
segments: I am the True Vine, and My Father is the Vinedresser.

entries.title: John 15:2
segments: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit, He takes away. And every one that bears fruit, He prunes it so that it may bring forth more fruit.

entries.title: John 15:3
segments: Now you are clean through the Word which I have spoken to you.

entries.title: John 15:4
segments: Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither [can] you unless you abide in Me.

entries.title: John 15:5
segments: I am the Vine, you [are] the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.

entries.title: John 15:6
segments: If anyone does not abide in Me, he is cast out as a branch and is withered. And they gather and cast [them] into the fire, and they are burned.

entries.title: John 15:7
segments: If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you shall ask what you will, and it shall be done to you.

entries.title: John 15:8
segments: In this My Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit, so you shall be My disciples.

entries.title: John 15:9
segments: As the Father has loved Me, so I have loved you; continue in My love.

entries.title: John 15:10
segments: If you keep My commandments, you shall abide in My love, even as I have kept My Father's commandments and abide in His love.

entries.title: John 15:11
segments: I have spoken these things to you so that My joy might remain in you and your joy might be full.

entries.title: John 15:12
segments: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

entries.title: John 15:13
segments: No one has greater love than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

entries.title: John 15:14
segments: You are My friends if you do whatever I command you.

entries.title: John 15:15
segments: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant does not know what his master does. But I have called you friends, for all things that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.

entries.title: John 15:16
segments: You have not chosen Me, but I have chosen you and ordained you that you should go and bring forth fruit, and [that] your fruit should remain; that whatever you shall ask of the Father in My name, He may give it to you.

entries.title: John 15:17
segments: These things I command you, that you love one another.

entries.title: John 15:18
segments: If the world hates you, you know that it hated Me before [it hated] you.

entries.title: John 15:19
segments: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

entries.title: John 15:20
segments: Remember the word that I said to you, The servant is not greater than his master. If they have persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they have kept My saying, they will also keep yours.

entries.title: John 15:21
segments: But all these things they will do to you for My name's sake, because they do not know Him who sent Me.

entries.title: John 15:22
segments: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

entries.title: John 15:23
segments: He who hates Me hates My Father also.

entries.title: John 15:24
segments: If I had not done among them the works which no other did, they would not have had sin. But now they have both seen and hated Me and My Father.

entries.title: John 15:25
segments: But that the Word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, "They hated Me without a cause."

entries.title: John 15:26
segments: And when the Comforter has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He shall testify of Me.

entries.title: John 15:27
segments: And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with Me from [the] beginning.
